theorems.name_zh: 有限阈值参考系的忠实同余像
theorems.assumptions: R>=2; K=GL6(Z_p); all normalized safe lattices
theorems.statement: K acts through PGL6(Z/p^(R-1)); kernel is scalar units times I+p^(R-1)M6.
theorems.boundary: Fixed p/threshold and allowed stochastic law; analytic frames are not native primitive rotations; no global atom-word, raw-coordinate, larger-threshold or physical claim.

theorems.name_zh: 无限阶剪切的有限观察阶及提升余量
theorems.assumptions: integer u !=0; off-diagonal Eij; fixed p,R
theorems.statement: Effective shear order is p^max(0,R-1-vp(u)); section multiplication defects can be nonzero while acting trivially on safe lattices.
theorems.boundary: Fixed p/threshold and allowed stochastic law; analytic frames are not native primitive rotations; no global atom-word, raw-coordinate, larger-threshold or physical claim.
